title: Write design/daw-presets.md: the kit to drum rack mapping and a minimal preset skeleton
description:
## Intent

Leave the spike's answer where the implementers will read it: `design/daw-presets.md`.

## Contents

- The mapping, kit -> drum rack:

| Apricity | In the preset |
|---|---|
| kit | drum rack preset (`<kit>.adg`) |
| slice n of a sliced kit | pad n, note 35 + n (pad 1 = C1) |
| named pad (`kick`, `snare`, `hat.closed` ...) | the usual drum note for that word; other names fill free pads |
| piece region (source seconds) | sampler sample start / end |
| level group gain (`apricity explain`) | sampler volume |
| A440 correction (`tuning_cents`) | sampler detune |
| the slice's root | sampler root key |
| warp markers of the sample (`rhythm.warp_markers`) | sampler warp markers, warp on |
| sample with no beat grid | warp off |

- An annotated minimal XML skeleton (element names, no vendor prose), and a Mermaid tree of it.
- The velocity comparison and the chosen sampler setting.
- A draft of the clip folder naming scheme (`A-1bar-Fm.alc`), for M3.
- A short "what a preset cannot hold" list (chord-following transposition, reverse, filter, track effects) with where each goes instead (the set export, apricitus-6edba8).
- Keep `design/vocabulary.md` in step: add rows for drum rack preset and clip file.

## Verification

`grep -c "|" design/daw-presets.md` shows the mapping table; the note links the reference fixtures by path; a reviewer checks each row against a reference file. a case-insensitive grep of design/ and docs/ for the vendor's name prints nothing.

## Release

`docs(<this task id>): design note for kit presets and the clip folder`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the annotation task in this epic.
